Bill.BriefDescription: Expanding the definition of an electric personal assistive mobility device.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to electric personal assistive mobility devices;amending RCW 46.04.1695; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.04.1695 and 2002 c 247 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Electric personal assistive mobility device" (EPAMD) means a selfbalancing device with one wheel or two wheels not in tandem, designedto transport only one person by an electric propulsion system with anaverage power of seven hundred fifty watts (one horsepower) if twowheeled or two thousand watts (two and twothirds horsepower) if onewheeled, having a maximum speed on a paved level surface, when poweredsolely by such a propulsion system while ridden by an operator weighingone hundred seventy pounds, of less than twenty miles per hour.
